title: Tension in OA
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the tension in rope OA as 250 N using vertical force equilibrium at point O.

title: Tension in OB
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the tension in rope OB as 150 N using horizontal force equilibrium at point O.

title: Friction Magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the frictional force on the person is 150 N from horizontal equilibrium.

title: Friction Direction
description: Important: Correctly identifies the direction of the frictional force as to the left (or opposite the rope pull).

title: Force Equilibrium at O
description: Important: Applies Newton's first law correctly to the junction point O, resolving forces into components.

title: Free-Body Diagram Logic
description: Optional: Shows or implies correct free-body diagrams for point O and/or the person.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Uses consistent units (N, kg, m/s²) and includes them in final answers.

title: Incorrect Angle Resolution
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies sine and cosine for the 37° angle when resolving the tension in OA.

title: Forgetting Friction Direction
description: Pitfall: Omits or incorrectly states the direction of the frictional force.

title: Person Equilibrium Omission
description: Pitfall: Fails to apply horizontal force equilibrium to the person to find the friction.
